name: Rosemary

schedule.notes: Buy a 4 in pot rather than seed-start — seedlings take 2 years to be useful.
Snip 6 in tips year-round in zone 7+. Below zone 7, overwinter in a pot indoors.

harvest.cues: Stems are firm, leaves needle-stiff. Strip with thumb and forefinger from tip toward base.
harvest.storageNotes: Excellent dried; flavor concentrates. Fresh stems keep a week in a damp paper towel.

varieties.name: Tuscan Blue
varieties.notes: Tall to 6 ft. Strongest flavor. The pizza/lamb standard.

varieties.name: Arp
varieties.notes: Hardy to zone 6 with mulch. Slightly less pungent.

notes: Below zone 7 it must come indoors for winter — pot it and give a south window with little water. Don't overwater inside; root rot is the #1 killer of houseplant rosemary.
